stages.text: Play the five chapters in order and finish the final mission. This stage alone earns 12 trophies: the four chapter trophies, the final-mission gold, and the story missions Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Take optional missions as they appear - the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' opens the bank-vault robberies. Scan vehicles and animals as you travel; it all counts later.
stages.title: Play the story: Chapters 1-4 and the finale

stages.text: Finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and complete 8 stranger strands in total for Strangers & Freaks. Start each chain as soon as it unlocks: TechWiser reports (single source) that some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress. Bret's strand ends with hunting a unique animal for Fair Game.
stages.time: During the story, about 10 hours of cleanup
stages.title: Side characters and strangers

stages.text: Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house - follow her and accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it to be safe. Then meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida's 10 locations (each counts double when both characters do it) and track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
stages.time: Minutes, if you are in Chapter 1
stages.title: The one missable trophy - do it in Chapter 1

stages.text: Work the activity trophies: 250 stunts (any 250 of 397; flying under bridges is quickest), gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone race win at each of the 14 locations, 20 different race wins, a fishing win over Cal, one finished arcade game, 50 challenges, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, a cocktail with a view is stage 7 - and sample every activity type once for Master of None.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.text: Explore every corner of Leonida (52 areas, clear the map fog - flying over dark patches is quickest), WAiNK It at 100 locations, scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK, complete 3 of the 15 Collectible Card sets, buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app (about $160,000; the 4 story garages do not count), and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
stages.time: Ongoing, then a sweep after the story
stages.title: World and collectibles

stages.text: Rob with your partner: lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back while still wanted, rob 5 bank vaults and escape (after the optional Chapter 4 mission), rob an armored truck and escape, rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs, steal a jet from VCIA and fly off, and take a tank from Mile Zero Air Station. Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and spend $100,000 across the shops along the way.
stages.time: After the story opens the map
stages.title: Crime and money

stages.text: Five trophies are not yet pinned down by the published guides (PowerPyx marks In The Beginning..., Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin as not yet known), so these are the honest best readings of their descriptions: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a showroom smash-out, a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, maxed Strength for both characters (GTABase, single source), 500 choices on your Criminal Profile (GTABase, single source), failing once then succeeding, a strange event somewhere in Leonida, and a melee drive-by.
stages.title: The odd ones out

stages.text: Attain 100% Completion for A Long Road - the hardest trophy, per PowerPyx and GTABase. The checklist asks for more than the trophies do in places (70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 30 races won, 8 bank vaults, all 15 card sets), but PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, and most of it is finished by working on the other trophies first. When A Long Road pops, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately.
stages.title: 100% completion, then the platinum

summary: One playthrough is enough, says PowerPyx: about 60-80 hours of story, about 100 hours on the 100% checklist, about 10 hours of cleanup - roughly 200 hours to the platinum, difficulty 4 out of 10. There is no mission replay, so keep a save at the start and end of each chapter. The order below is built from the official trophy descriptions: story chapters and missions first, then the side characters, then the one missable trophy, then activities, collectibles, crime and money, the odd ones out, and 100% completion last.
title: Platinum roadmap: Vice Got a Price!
